findings.description: Current CI gate is 63%, below the required repository and module thresholds.
Version is embedded directly in pyproject and duplicated in src/aspenops_nexus/__init__.py.
source == target returns before unit lookup, so an unsupported unit can be accepted when both strings match.
If exactly one of source or target is None, conversion silently returns the value instead of rejecting ambiguous dimensional semantics.
NaN and Infinity are not rejected.
Absolute temperature and temperature differences are not separated; absolute and gauge pressure are not separated.
UnitSpec does not enforce finite positive scale or finite offset.
json.dumps does not set allow_nan=False; NaN and Infinity can enter a supposedly canonical identity.
Equivalent physical values are not normalized for negative zero, units or display-only fields.
There is no pending owner, lease, single-flight or stale-owner recovery; concurrent misses can launch duplicate Aspen solves.
ON CONFLICT overwrites existing payloads without immutable publish semantics.
Payloads have no checksum, schema version, corruption state or transactional publish protocol.
No size bound, eviction policy or version invalidation is defined.
Status and cancel_requested have no CHECK constraints; no schema version, idempotency key, optimistic version, lease or migration ledger exists.
fail updates any job regardless of current state, allowing terminal jobs to be rewritten.
complete ignores rowcount, so stale or duplicate completion silently appears successful.
Every JobStore construction rewrites all running rows to interrupted, corrupting live work if a second service starts.
list_recent selects IDs and opens a new connection/query for every row.
No explicit PENDING→CLAIMED→RUNNING→terminal state machine or owner/lease preconditions.
All exceptions are collapsed to an unstructured string without stable error taxonomy or traceback evidence.
No tests cover NaN/Inf, missing units, unsupported same-unit strings, delta temperature, gauge/absolute pressure or round-trip properties.
Formatting, branch coverage, release consistency, database/state/evidence validators and independent wheel commands are absent.
Coverage gate is 63%, below requested thresholds.
Runner labels are [self-hosted, Windows, Aspen], not [self-hosted, Windows, aspen, licensed].
The workflow lacks explicit model/registry hash qualification, perturbation, fault injection, manifest verification and release-blocking physically_certified output.
